description: Sends one prompt to another AI model through the Ezkielyna API and returns its answer with the tokens used, latency and an estimated cost. Use it for a second opinion, a translation, or a task another model handles well. Default model deepseek-v4.1-flash. Paid (pay-as-you-go balance); counts toward the session cap. Run list_models to see model ids and prices.

max_tokens.description: Maximum answer length in tokens (default 1024, cap 4096).

prompt.description: The question or task for the model (include any code or context it needs; it cannot see this conversation).

system.description: Optional system prompt, e.g. "You are a strict code reviewer. Answer in Indonesian."

temperature.description: Optional sampling temperature (0-2). Leave empty for the model default.

name: ask_model
title: Tanya model lain / Ask another AI model
